source: Live captures of codex-cli 0.165.0 and Claude Code 2.1.312 (macOS, tmux), 2026-10-29: the startup folder-trust prompt of each, nothing answered and nothing saved to the trust config. Codex run directly in tmux (w80, w120, w200) and through hoptell tmux (option 2 is Quit there, Back to Agent Command Center otherwise). Rows: capture-pane -p; cursor: cursor_x, cursor_y; size: the pane size. Temporary paths are replaced with same-length placeholders. Codex in a linked worktree of an untrusted repository (w120, w200, 2026-10-30), run directly in tmux with a prompt: the variant that also names the repository root, the folder Codex trusts; no cursor recorded (cursor: null). Claude Code 2.1.314 and agy 1.4.11 (2026-10-30), each run directly in tmux, nothing trusted: the dialog at w80, w120 and w200, in a linked worktree, a subfolder, under a member's launch line, with the other row selected, and the screens that are not it (Claude Code's permission variant and a folder with a project .mcp.json, agy after one ctrl+c, agy's input once trusted); the home folder is a same-length placeholder too.
